title: Tom's Day of Meals
text:
Tom has breakfast at seven o'clock. He eats an egg and drinks a cup of tea. He likes bread with jam too. Breakfast is his favorite meal.

At noon, Tom eats lunch at school. Today he has rice and chicken. After lunch he eats an apple. In the evening, his family eats dinner together.

questions.text: What does Tom eat for breakfast?
What does Tom have for lunch today?
How does Tom probably feel about his breakfast?
options: He is too tired to eat it

questions.text: Why does Tom's family probably eat dinner together?
options: They like to spend time together

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
the meal you eat in the middle of the day
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening
a round fruit, often red or green

paragraph_translations: Том снідає о сьомій годині. Він їсть яйце і п'є чашку чаю. Він також любить хліб із джемом. Сніданок — його улюблена їжа.
О полудні Том обідає в школі. Сьогодні в нього рис і курка. Після обіду він їсть яблуко. Ввечері його родина вечеряє разом.
